small_guidance:
- Add larger M tiles (e.g. BLOCK_M=128/256 with BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=16/32) since OC=32 is small but per-(N,OC_tile) the GEMM-M dimension equals OC=32 — better to make BLOCK_M cover all OC in one tile (BLOCK_M=32) and push BLOCK_N (output spatial) larger (128/256) with num_warps=8, num_stages=3 to maximize K-reuse of weights.
- Swap the program grid so pid_0 iterates over (N × OC_tiles) and pid_1 over spatial tiles, and preload the entire weight slab (OC×K_TOTAL = 32×216 = ~27KB) once per program by making BLOCK_K cover K_TOTAL fully (BLOCK_K=256 with K_TOTAL=216 masked) — eliminates the K loop and reuses weights across spatial tiles.
- Tighten autotune key to include (N, OUT_SP) and prune configs; current 38 configs cause long autotune; keep ~6 best (e.g. (32,128,32), (32,256,32), (32,128,64)) at num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as a persistent, weight-resident kernel: since OC*K_TOTAL = 32*216 = 6912 fp32 (~27KB) fits easily in SMEM/registers, load the full weight matrix once per program and stream output-spatial tiles, fusing the conv+ReLU+GELU+sigmoid+bias epilogue. This removes the outer K loop entirely and turns the kernel into a single large GEMM-K reduction per tile.
- Switch input layout to NDHWC (channels-last) so the K dimension (IC × kd × kh × kw) is contiguous in memory; gather along K becomes coalesced fp32x8 loads. Pre-permute x once in forward (cheap relative to conv) and write out in NCDHW at the end (or keep NDHWC and permute output).
- Consider splitting spatial into (od, oh, ow_tile) and unrolling KD/KH at compile time (KD=KH=KW=3 constexpr) so the inner loop becomes 27 fully-unrolled FMA blocks over IC — this gives the compiler full visibility of the 3×3×3 stencil and removes index arithmetic from the hot loop.
